title: Render the workspace protocol from the project at init
action: In verbs/protocol.rs replace the fixed TEMPLATE render with a render from the control root per CONTEXT D1-D6 (keep a pure fn `render_protocol(facts) -> String` and a fn that gathers the facts from the root, so tests feed fake facts and temp git repos). Read git through the crate's existing git helpers where one exists (no new dependency); strip `user[:pass]@` from the origin URL. Read `uat_stop` through the existing config reader. The rendered file must check `valid` with protocol_state, hold no placeholder and no FULL_TEST or other test command. Output: text mode prints `wrote <path>`, then one next line naming the review files and the judgment work (D6); `--json` carries `ok, path, facts:[{key,value,source}], review:[paths]`. D7: add `--print` (text: the rendered file on stdout; json: `rendered` plus facts and review); it writes nothing and works when a file exists; without it an existing file still returns the protocol_exists refusal unchanged. Declare `--print` and the new output in registry_payload.json under protocol.init. If the flag name `print` is new to the catalog, raise PINNED_FLAG_COUNT in catalog.rs by exactly the new names, citing c5e4d24a. Tests: a temp git repo with origin `https://u:p@example.com/o/r.git` and origin/HEAD renders REPOSITORY_REMOTE without `u:p@` and DEFAULT_BRANCH from origin/HEAD; no origin leaves both keys out (branch falls back to the current branch); uat_stop merge vs absent gives the two MERGE_OWNER texts; scripts/release.sh present gives the DEPLOY_OWNER line naming it, a `.github/workflows/release.yml` alone names that, none gives `human`; a present `.claude/skills` dir adds its PROTECTED_AREAS item, an absent one does not; the render checks valid and has a Sources line per derived key; `review` lists only existing files; --print on an existing file returns the render and leaves the file bytes unchanged; init on an existing file still refuses. No code comments.
